message.content:
Yes—you can file a noise‑complaint with the City of Atlanta.  Noise complaints are handled by the city’s **Code Enforcement** and **Public Safety** offices, and the city council can forward the complaint to the appropriate department if needed.

### How to File a Noise Complaint in Atlanta

| Method | What to Do | Contact / Link |
|--------|------------|----------------|
| **Phone (311)** | Call 311 (or 404‑656‑3111) from any phone.  The dispatcher will take your complaint and route it to the correct department. | 311 – 404‑656‑3111 |
| **Online Form** | Use the City of Atlanta’s online complaint portal.  Select “Noise” under the “Type of Complaint” dropdown. | [Atlanta 311 Online](https://www.atlantaga.gov/311) |
| **City Hall** | Visit the City Hall (1200 Peachtree Street NE, Atlanta, GA 30303) and speak with the Code Enforcement office. | City Hall – 1200 Peachtree St NE |
| **Email** | Send an email to the City’s Code Enforcement office. | code.enforcement@atlantaga.gov |
| **City Council Representative** | If you prefer, you can contact your local city council member.  They can forward the complaint to the city’s enforcement office. | Find your council member here: <https://www.atlantaga.gov/government/city-council> |

### Relevant City Ordinance

Atlanta’s noise ordinance is codified in the **Atlanta Municipal Code, Title 10 – Public Safety, Chapter 10.1 – Noise**.  It sets permissible noise levels and defines “unreasonable noise” that can be reported.  You can read the full ordinance here:

- **Atlanta Municipal Code – Noise Ordinance**  
  <https://www.atlantaga.gov/government/departments/department-of-public-safety/department-of-public-safety-noise-ordinance>

### Quick Tips

1. **Provide Details** – When filing, give the exact location, time, and nature of the noise (e.g., loud music, construction, barking dogs).  
2. **Record the Complaint** – Keep a copy of the complaint form or a note of the phone call (date, time, dispatcher name).  
3. **Follow Up** – If the noise persists, you can follow up with the same contact method or ask the council member for assistance.

By using any of the above methods, you can officially report noise disturbances to the City of Atlanta and have them investigated by the appropriate city department.
